description: This file defines the ExceptionSerializationOptions class used for configuring exception serialization, including supported namespace prefixes and a filter predicate for exception types.

classes.name: ExceptionSerializationOptions
classes.description: Contains settings for exception serialization, including supported namespace prefixes and a custom filter predicate.

methods.name: SupportedNamespacePrefixes.get
methods.description: Retrieves the collection of namespace prefixes supported for serialization.

methods.name: SupportedExceptionTypeFilter.get
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the predicate used to determine if an exception type is serializable.
